principle: Spend tokens where they buy correctness, never where they don't. Defaults are the cheapest model that does the job well; escalation is by evidence, not by habit. Helpers never run on Fable.

escalate.reviewer: Run the SECOND review round on opus (pass `model: "opus"` to the Agent call) when the first round returned 2+ Act-on items, or the diff spans more than 10 source files, or it touches concurrency, auth, or money outside the highRisk globs.
escalate.skeptic: Stays on sonnet; a plan is one page. Skip the huddle entirely for a bugfix or refactor whose plan touches a single file — the playbooks do not require it there.
escalate.qa: Stays on opus: the tests are what catch the bugs you are losing to. For a one-case change, hand QA that one case; cost follows the case table, not the model.

never: spawn a helper the rules do not require (a doc-only or test-only change needs no reviewer)
re-run `gate verify` to 'be safe' when verify.json is already fresh — the gate checks freshness by content hash
